liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Wharf Rat** (2 reviews): Midway through the song, Bobby's guitar is pushed up to an extremely loud level in the mix; Described as beautiful, with Jerry's lead playing sparkling and colorful [5][8]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Reviewer listened to the Truckin' into Drums into The Other One sequence, noting Billy's drum solo leading into Phil's entrance [12]
- **Hard To Handle** (1 review): A romping version ending in a crescendo led by Jerry's very fast bluegrass-style picking [8]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 other source): Not Fade Away is split around Goin' Down The Road Feelin' Bad, with segues linking the pieces [1]
- Reviewer singles out Jerry's vocals as especially good throughout the show [11]

## The recordings

- **gd71-04-21.sbd.kaplan.8227.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 136 min; rated 4.57/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds this soundboard hissy, which they attribute to the building's electrical issues and the recording gear being set up again; Reviewer hears no hiss on the stream and considers the sound excellent; Reviewer says this recording has less hiss than most commercial live albums of the era [5][6][7]
- **gd1971-04-21.sbd.130598.MrBill.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 134 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears an odd treble quality in this remastered version, like poor-quality mp3s [16]
- **gd1971-04-21.141116.sbd.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 135 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd1971-04-21.sbd.lai.2578.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 136 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer calls it peak Dead, in the same league as the Harpur College show [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd71-04-21.sbd.kaplan.8227.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Michael Lai and Seth Kaplan; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Reviewer previously had an incomplete cassette from Prime Cuts on Long Island, which stopped after Me and Bobby McGee; Chain is MSR to reel to DAT to CD, digital audio extraction, then SHN; Seth Kaplan fixed sector boundaries in an earlier SHN set [1][9]
- **gd1971-04-21.sbd.130598.MrBill.flac16**: transferred by Bill Guarneri; source: Recording Info: SBD > R > DAT >CD; Transfer Info: CD >WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC; Remastered, retracked version of shnid 8227 [4]
- **gd1971-04-21.141116.sbd.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Reels > 1st generation reels > 2nd generation reels > PCM (Sony HG tape); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD >… [2]
- **gd1971-04-21.sbd.lai.2578.sbefail.shnf**: source: sdb>>MR>>PCM>>CD [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by rirocks.net: [Grateful Dead 1971 04.21](https://rirocks.net/Band%20Articles/Grateful%20Dead%201971%2004.21%20-%20RI%20Auditorium.htm) [18]
- Fan art by www.rirocks.net: [Grateful Dead 1971 04.21](http://www.rirocks.net/Band%20Articles/Grateful%20Dead%201971%2004.21%20-%20RI%20Auditorium.htm) [19]
